highlights.title: Nepal floods leave 22,000 children without safe water: UNICEF
highlights.summary: More than a week after flash floods struck the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli river basin in Nepal, at least 22,000 children urgently need safe drinking water, sanitation and hygiene support, the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.

highlights.title: El Niño is surging. Months of extreme heat could follow
highlights.summary: Fuelled by exceptionally warm Pacific waters, the El Niño climate pattern is intensifying and has yet to peak. Forecasters are almost certain it will persist through February 2027 – with unusually warm conditions expected across much of the world in the coming months.

highlights.title: One in five children in 21 nations faced tech-facilitated sexual abuse: UNICEF
highlights.summary: About 20 million children aged 12 to 17 – one in five across 21 countries – were sexually exploited by perpetrators using technology such as social media, according to a UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) report released on Thursday.

highlights.title: For Russia and Ukraine, an Escalating Spiral With No End in Sight
highlights.summary: Each side is using missiles and drones to try to pound the other into giving up, breeding ceaseless human suffering. But there is no sign that either country’s determination will weaken.

highlights.title: ACM Neto e Jerônimo empatam no 2º turno na Bahia, diz Atlas/Intel
highlights.summary: Candidato do União Brasil tem 49,2% contra 48,6% do atual governador petista

highlights.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies at 92
highlights.summary: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".
